The front of the hypnotic pocket watch cannot directly change people's thoughts, but can only leave psychological hints.  Hints are divided into 10 levels.  Each hypnotic suggestion starts at level 1. Each time the hypnotic suggestion is deepened, the level of the hypnotic suggestion will increase by 1 to 3 levels.  Level 10 is the highest, which means you fully accept the hypnotic suggestion and fully follow the instructions described in the suggestion.  For example, the suggestion "I like the smell of feet wearing stockings, and I like the smell of stockings that have not been washed for several days." Level 1, less affected, only feels that the smell of stockings is not as bad as before.  Levels 2 to 3 feel that the smell of stockings is unpleasant but fragrant.  Levels 4 to 6 feel that the smell of stockings is getting weaker and weaker, but the fragrance is getting stronger and stronger.  At levels 7 to 9, when you see stockings, you will start to smell them.  Level 10 will fully accept this hypnotic suggestion and will become obsessed with wearing smelly, dirty stockings on their legs for several days.
